scope_description.value: Electrical coordination study on the distribution system for Gloucester County Well Pump No. 1, including field survey, short circuit study using SKM Power Tools, equipment evaluation, time current curve (TCC) development, and recommended protective device settings to achieve compromised coordination in accordance with ANSI/NEMA MTS-2019.
scope_description.quote: Bowman, Foster & Associates, Inc. (BFA) was tasked with performing an electrical coordination study on the distribution system for the Gloucester County Well Pump #1. The coordination study included the following: 1. Survey the Well Pump and generate a model of the system using SKM Power Tools. 2. Conduct a short circuit study of the Well Pump electrical system using SKM software. 3. Use the results of the survey and the short circuit current study to perform recommended measures to coordinate the tripping characteristics of protective devices.

corroboration.claim: coordination study on the distribution system for the Gloucester County Well Pump #1
BFA recommends the Instantaneous trip setting as shown on the TCC Setting Report to achieve a Compromised coordination
corroboration.value: Compromised coordination with recommended instantaneous trip settings

key_finding_equipment_evaluation.value: No equipment was found to have failed the Equipment Evaluation. All protective devices passed the ANSI Fault Analysis criteria (calculated fault current < 90% of equipment rating).
key_finding_equipment_evaluation.quote: After completion of the equipment evaluation, no pieces of equipment were found to have failed the evaluation.

corroboration.claim: No equipment was found to have failed the Equipment Evaluation
no pieces of equipment were found to have failed the evaluation

key_finding_coordination.value: Selective coordination cannot be fully achieved; compromised coordination is required and achievable by applying recommended instantaneous trip settings. Specifically, two 600 A circuit breakers in series (Main Switchboard CB PNL DP-1 and PNL DP-1 MCB) are not required to be selectively coordinated per NEC 2023.
key_finding_coordination.source: Time Current Curves section and Recommended System Modifications
key_finding_coordination.quote: The Study shows the existing distribution system overcurrent protective devices must be coordinated. After completion of the Study, BFA recommends the Instantaneous trip setting as shown on the TCC Setting Report to achieve a Compromised coordination.

corroboration.claim: Well Pump circuit breakers Instantaneous trip settings cannot be fully selectively coordinated

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Both names used; treated as co-names for the same facility/system
conflict_flags.rationale: The study report header and footer consistently say 'Well No. 1 Coordination Study' while the one-line diagram title blocks say 'Electrical Coordination Study - Raw Water No. 2 Treatment Plant'. The Well Pump #1 is fed from the same electrical distribution system serving the Raw Water No. 2 Treatment Plant. These are not conflicting project identities — Well Pump #1 is one load on that plant's distribution system. Minor inconsistency in title treatment only.
